# gyro_apps (Data Source)

One-click apps that can be used for gyro_app_install.app (and the app option of a server order).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# All one-click apps
data "gyro_apps" "all" {}

# Apps listed under "Popular in Türkiye" that run on Ubuntu 24.04
data "gyro_apps" "popular" {
  popular_tr = true
  os         = "ubuntu-24.04"
}

output "popular_app_ids" {
  value = [for a in data.gyro_apps.popular.apps : a.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `category` (String) Filter by category id, e.g. web, panel, yapayzeka.
- `os` (String) Only apps that support this image slug, e.g. ubuntu-24.04.
- `popular_tr` (Boolean) true: only apps listed under "Popular in Türkiye".

### Read-Only

- `apps` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--apps))

<a id="nestedatt--apps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `apps`

Read-Only:

- `category` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `license` (String)
- `min_cpu` (Number)
- `min_disk_gb` (Number)
- `min_ram_gb` (Number) Minimum RAM in GB; choose a plan with at least this much.
- `name` (String)
- `needs_domain` (Boolean)
- `os` (List of String)
- `popular_tr` (Boolean)
- `version` (String)
